articles.title: Whistleblowers reveal secret UFO program at Maryland Navy base ongoing since the 1950s
articles.summary: Whistleblowers allege the U.S. Navy has secretly housed an "exotic vehicle of unknown origin" at Naval Air Station Patuxent River for decades. They claim the Navy is studying advanced non-human technology. This revelation prompts discussion on classified defence operations, technological implications, and government transparency, potentially influencing national security dialogues.

articles.title: Will the ocean crush you?
articles.summary: This article explores the immense pressures found in the deep sea, revealing that venturing unprotected to extreme depths can be fatal due to the ocean's crushing force. It underscores the incredible power of natural environments and the necessity of specialized protection for human survival and exploration in such hazardous conditions. This insight is valuable for SSB aspirants considering challenges in diverse operational settings.
